check.prompt: What is the difference between authentication and authorization?
options: Authentication proves who you are, and authorization decides what you may do
They mean exactly the same thing
Authorization proves who you are, and authentication decides what you may do
check.explanation: First the system checks who you are, then it checks what that person is allowed to do.
check.hint: One is identity, the other is permission.

check.prompt: How should a website store passwords?
options: As plain text, so they can be shown to users who forget
As salted hashes, never as plain text
check.explanation: A salted hash cannot be turned back into the password, so even a leaked database does not reveal passwords.
check.hint: Could you ever need to read a password back?

check.prompt: Why is the placeholder in the SQL example safer than pasting the input into the query?
options: It keeps input as plain data, so it cannot change the query
It makes the query run faster
It removes the need to validate input
check.explanation: With a placeholder the database treats the input only as a value, so special characters cannot rewrite the query.
check.hint: What could attacker text do if it became part of the query itself?
